exposure: aspiration of 0.2 ml of CSF after spinal anesthesia with hyperbaric 0.5% bupivacaine
outcome: extent of sensory and motor block
time to reach maximum level of anesthesia
incidence of bradycardia, hypotension, headache, vomiting and nausea
cohort: 60 pregnant women at or after 37 weeks of gestation, aged 18-46 years, scheduled for cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: Aspiration of 0.2 ml of CSF after injection of spinal anesthesia with hyperbaric 0.5% bupivacaine does not appear to affect the extent of sensory and motor block, success rate, or outcome after spinal anesthesia in cesarean section.
